folds.heading: ## Interface-use reconciliation B114, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
Full [INTERFACES](INTERFACES.md), [OVERLAPS](OVERLAPS.md), [MINIMAL_SET](MINIMAL_SET.md) and REPORT read, preserving AB1–AB12/O1–O5/D1–D4/F1–F5/R1–R5. Stable person/body/life/source-instance refs, operational axes, frozen quotes and transmission inputs, one custody count, viewer-safe dated claims and permanent outcome receipts remain useful. A universal truth registry is not a CV1 prerequisite; claims and truth keep separate owners. Namespace comic versus genetics CA codes. No renderer may infer visible staleness from private truth or initialize a stream. Existing keyed RNG service is the default; its bounded log is not settlement authority.

AD51 in [RULES_INDEX](../../../../RULES_INDEX.md) qualifies the packet’s repeated two-implemented-world/method prerequisites: design a reasonable seam from known world needs, then validate/revise with a different case. Selected runtime still needs real consumers and delivery proof; these recommendations neither launch four checkpoints nor impose a new global build order. AD42 makes human review optional, and current desktop/laptop direction governs the viewport rather than a universal 1366-only floor. B107’s card-specific carry correction does not establish general retained-world/soul inheritance. Legacy migration is conditional on selection, not a new mandatory work item. Historical source locators, read lists and structural checks do not grant current API proof or this pass reading of unread dependencies. All original proposal/history remains in place.

folds.heading: ## Body-interface reconciliation B114, 2026-11-04
folds.body: The complete [B18 interface packet](gm/dispatch/body-lineage-2026-10-14/b18/REPORT.md#interface-use-reconciliation-b114-2026-11-04) now has scoped reconciliation of AB1–AB12, comic/genetics namespace collisions, claim/truth/custody boundaries and frozen event inputs. Reuse actual owners and the existing keyed stream service. AD51 permits design from known needs before a second implemented case; the four staged recommendations remain unselected. AD42 human review is optional. No generic genome, soul transfer, population or sample engine is required by this paperwork; selected integration must establish its own current APIs, admission and delivery evidence.
